entries.suggested_post:
Self-custody means nobody can touch my seed phrase.

It's on a sticky note. On the router.

Where's yours? Wrong answers only.
entries.suggested_alt:
Not your keys, not your coins.

My keys, also not my coins. I laminated the Wi-Fi password.
entries.image_alt: Navy card: Self-custody: nobody can touch my seed phrase. It's on a sticky note. On the router.
entries.why_shareable: Relatable self-custody fear any holder or newcomer gets; tag-a-friend angle
entries.cta: Save this as your reminder to move that sticky note.

entries.format: This Is Fine (dog in burning room)
entries.suggested_post: Leverage is great. You get to experience a whole bear market in four minutes.
entries.suggested_alt:
50x long. Room's on fire. Coffee's still warm. We're fine.

What's the most leverage you've ever regretted?
entries.image_alt: This is fine dog: Me, 4 minutes into my 50x long
entries.why_shareable: Format everyone knows; universal leverage pain, invites "been there" replies
entries.cta: If this was you, a repost helps the next guy step away from the 50x button.

visual_suggestion.description: This Is Fine-style scene (original cartoon dog, not the copyrighted art): calm dog at a desk sipping coffee as a phone shows a lime '50x LONG' position; the room slowly fills with flames as a red candle drops; dog says 'this is fine'. Caption on top: 'Me, 4 minutes into my 50x long'. 6-8 s, loopable.
visual_suggestion.style_note: Deep navy background, Bitcoin in white, lime accents, exact logo watermark (assets/logo-watermark.png) bottom-right.

entries.hook: Fed FOMC rate decision is today, Oct 28
entries.suggested_post:
Fed day.

I will not be reading the statement. I will be watching a 1-minute candle have a nervous breakdown.

Statement readers or candle watchers?
entries.suggested_alt: FOMC day: 400 words from the Fed, 4,000 candles from me.
entries.image_alt: Drake meme: rejects reading the Fed's rate decision, approves watching the 1-minute Bitcoin chart have a panic attack about it
entries.why_shareable: Format everyone knows; tied to today's Fed decision so it dates fast
entries.cta: Bookmark it for the next Fed day. There's always a next Fed day.

entries.hook: Halloween week; spooky-season formats trending (TikTok trend reports, Oct 2026)
entries.suggested_post:
Halloween costume this year: guy who was promised a post-halving bull run.

No makeup needed. Just waited.
entries.suggested_alt: Still waiting on the halving pump. At this point I'm not HODLing, I'm decomposing.
entries.image_alt: Waiting skeleton on a bench: Me waiting for the bull run I was promised last halving
entries.why_shareable: Known format plus Halloween week; halving-wait pain is relatable but seasonal
entries.cta: Save this for next Halloween. You'll probably still be waiting.

visual_suggestion.description: Time-lapse of a skeleton on a park bench holding a phone with a Bitcoin chart: seasons cycle behind it (leaves fall, snow, spring) while text 'waiting for the post-halving bull run' stays on top; ends on a lime 'still HODLing' tag. 6-10 s.
visual_suggestion.style_note: Deep navy background, Bitcoin in white, lime accents, exact logo watermark (assets/logo-watermark.png) bottom-right.

entries.hook: Google Trends: 'bitcoin' search interest at a five-year low (X News, Oct 27)
entries.suggested_post:
Google searches for Bitcoin just hit a five-year low.

So it's not just my family.

Who in your house stopped asking?
entries.suggested_alt:
Bitcoin search interest is at a five-year low.

Finally, the whole internet reacts to Bitcoin the way my group chat does.
entries.image_alt: Navy card: Bitcoin Google searches just hit a five-year low. So it's not just my family.
entries.why_shareable: Needs the news hook (search interest low) to land; dates fast
entries.cta: Repost it for everyone who's been orange-pilling an empty room. Follow for the next one.
